name: Small wind turbines
summary: Complete small wind generators, about 100W to a few kW, from boats, cabins, farms and remote sites.
uses: Charging batteries where wind is steady
Power at night and in winter when solar is weak
Spare alternator, blades and hub for a homemade turbine
identify: Three to five blades on a pole with a tail or a pod, often 1–3 m across, on boats, RVs, farm sheds, remote huts and monitoring stations. Look for a charge controller and a dump-load resistor nearby.
test: Lower the mast first; never climb to a spinning rotor. With the output wires apart the hub should spin freely, and with them shorted together it should get much harder to turn.

decay.note: The generator lasts; bearings, blades and wiring wear when left spinning unattended.
